audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5]/win[5] read 'Skill' while the packet chart gives Vayne the First-item row, and the page's own whys[5] and spikes[2].text say Vayne 'pulls firmly ahead' there. Separately, whys[3] and whys[4] are shifted one row: whys[3] sits on the Levels 4-5 row but describes level 6 Maiden, and whys[4] on the Level 6 row opens 'After the 6 spike'.
audit.why: A row labelled Skill next to text saying you pull firmly ahead is two answers to one question, and the shifted whys mean the Levels 4-5 row explains a stage that has not happened yet.
audit.corrected: phases[5]/win[5] set to Vayne with the rating raised; whys[3] rewritten for Levels 4-5 and whys[4] for Level 6. Row 3 left as Skill, which is what the packet chart says.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why named Blade of the Ruined King as the spike but not what it beats; the anti-heal timing was missing.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, so an extended trade is settled by Grievous Wounds, not by raw damage.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now pairs the item with Grievous Wounds against Last Rites.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d carried no cooldowns or ranges, and the two decisive facts were absent: Dark Procession's wall is destructible, and Mourning Mist marks you so the Mist Walkers gain move speed toward you.
audit.why: Riot's W text says 'destructible wall' — you break out rather than walk around, which changes what being caged costs. Riot's E text says 'Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', which is why the globule, not the ghouls, is the thing to dodge. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s at 600 range; Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8s at 700 and shreds armour.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the ranges, cooldowns, the destructible wall and the mark-to-ghoul-speed link.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession was tracked as the punishable cooldown with no number, and Mourning Mist's shorter 12s cooldown was never mentioned even though it is what actually reaches you.
audit.why: Trading 'after the cage' is wrong advice if the 12s armour-shred globule is still up.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns stated in phases[3].why and whys[3].

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The even patch: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1, but Mourning Mist is 12s and shreds armour, so trade only after he throws it.

edits.before: Level 6 Maiden plus W-cage-into-E-slime is his one window to chunk you — an even skill check.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are the even patch — Dark Procession is 20s, but Mourning Mist is only 12s.

edits.before: After the 6 spike your Final Hour repositioning re-establishes control over the ghouls.
edits.after: At 6 Final Hour's Tumble resets reposition you out of the cage before Maiden lands.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King plus Grievous Wounds beats Last Rites' heal — force fights the moment it completes.

edits.before: Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is a 600-range wall on 20s — commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: Yorick wastes Dark Procession (Cage) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The wall is destructible — break through it rather than walk the long way.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you and speeds every ghoul at you — dodge the globule.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Maiden makes his autos on her target hit harder — kill her first.

notes: The packet flags 'level chart contradicts data: Vayne wins only 46.55% but the chart gives Vayne 6/7 stages vs 0'.
